mainEntity.name: How do you conduct an AEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our AEO website audit process involves several key steps. We begin with a deep dive into your website's technical foundation, content, and existing analytics. Next, we employ specialized AI-driven tools to analyze how large language models perceive your content, identify key entities, and assess semantic accuracy. We evaluate user intent signals and data relevance. Finally, we compile a comprehensive report with prioritized recommendations for content optimization, technical adjustments, and data structuring to maximize AI visibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our AEO audit analyzes your website's technical aspects, content, and analytics using AI tools to assess how AI perceives your site and provides actionable recommendations.
